title: Ori and the Will of the Wisps
shortDescription: Ori ventures beyond Nibel into the blighted land of Niwen, introducing active melee combat shards and spirit trials.
historicalSignificance: Universally heralded as one of the finest Metroidvania platformers ever created with sublime movement fluidity.
